profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer | Building Scalable Solutions for Government & Enterprise Clients
profile.summary: I'm a dedicated software engineer with over 15 years of experience building web applications and improving development processes. I have a strong track record of delivering projects on time while maintaining high code quality standards. My expertise spans both frontend and backend development, with strength in creating efficient testing frameworks and enhancing user experiences. I enjoy collaborating with teams and have experience mentoring new developers.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Plant City, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Architected and implemented a custom API module to handle HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE, PUT) for multiple content types, improving data management efficiency. Developed end-to-end test automation framework using Cypress and Playwright, reducing manual testing time.
Engineered integration between public sites and internal government data sources, enabling real-time data synchronization.
Designed and implemented a report data snapshot system, allowing clients to access customized report views based on specific requirements.
Created comprehensive test scripts covering both frontend and backend functionality, achieving 95% test coverage.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed and updated multiple highly visible and time sensitive Websites such as HHS.gov, Healthcare.gov, Stopbullying.gov, Foodsafety.gov, Flu.gov, LetsMove.gov and the old Healthreform.gov site using Percussion Rythmyx. Developed and maintained an HHS Website for President Obama’s Open Government Initiative .

positions.title: Content Manager / Graphics Design / Email Developer
positions.description: Duties Include: Assigned various duties including web page maintenance and design of various banners and button graphics that are used on the site. Created various email templates to be used for their external email blasts.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Assigned various duties including web page maintenance and design of various home / content page(s). Utilize the Rhythmyx CMS to maintain three of the OCC web content. Created various email templates to be used by the client for their internal emails.

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer
positions.description: Duties Include: being able to complete both front-end web design and HTML/CSS coding. Build HTML web pages, rich media content, website text edits and banner updates. Adhere to design standards that are set forth by management.

company.name: The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts

positions.title: Web and Application Support Specialist
positions.description: Duties Include: Web page maintenance and design of various home / content page(s). Created various email templates to be used by the client for their internal or external emails. Assist the client with navigating through the DDC Content Manage application. Create small banners to be used within the clients email blasts. Actively participates in the testing and implementation of new web sites.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: Duties Include: Assists in the planning, design, documentation, and implementation of various systems to include desktop PC’s, servers, network equipment, and software applications.   Monitors and maintains the use of the library’s photocopiers and printers.  Develops, maintains, and monitors procedures for all server backups.   Monitors, plans, and coordinates the distribution of client/server software and service packs.  Makes recommendations for new equipment and services to purchase and works with various vendors for procurement.  Perform on-site and remote technical support.  Assist in the organization and inventory of all hardware and software resources.  Maintains excellent communication with the IT Manager on all tasks and projects. Creates and maintains good technical documentation. Provides emergency on-call support on a rotating schedule. Performs other duties as assigned.

positions.title: Account Support Supervisor
positions.description: Duties Include: As part of the Network Operations Leadership Team, coordinate daily activities of helpdesk support personnel who provide the technical expertise needed to resolve customer problems for the DMDC end-user community. Provide technical direction relating to system performance, telecommunications, hardware, software, operating systems and utilities for 49 employees. Interface with multiple EDS groups to resolve customer problems. Facilitate inter-team communications between application developers and support teams to obtain, document, and implement new or existing requirements for the helpdesk. Interact with various levels of EDS and Government management to establish and gather requirements for the helpdesk. Analyze daily and monthly metrics to identify staffing, individual/team performance, and training needs, and ensure that these are addressed. Assign, direct, track and aid in planning the work of support personnel. Assisted in establishing the TRICARE Next Generation helpdesk, which supports the implementation of over 25 military medical applications that impact more than 23 million DoD civilian and military personnel. Help to establish and improve helpdesk processes and procedures to increase productivity, enhance overall helpdesk performance, decrease customer wait time, and improve the efficiency and proficiency of the helpdesk personnel. Responsible for obtaining technical and business-related training for helpdesk personnel.

positions.title: Knowledge Base Manager
positions.description: Duties Include: Managing the knowledge base core review team, the development of the knowledge base tools, processes, and workflows. Lead KB core review team meetings to help create, review, modify, and publish articles to be stored in a database and posted on the internal Knowledge Base sites. Create policies and procedures to ensure quality of content. Worked closely with DSC Leadership team on feedback loops, content for new releases, and updates of existing content. Work closely with Tier 1 and Tier 2 agents to understand common questions, the challenges faced by our customers, and receive KB suggestions. Work with the Product Release Teams, Client Services Team and the Technical Support Team to ensure product information, usage instructions, procedural instructions, release notes, and associated product information is available in the Knowledge Base system. Mentor and coach various teams on proper Knowledge Base articles, and usage.

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst/Contractor
positions.description: Duties Include: providing customer service for an inbound call center environment that supports hardware, software, and communications for various Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) applications. Researched and resolve caller inquiries by utilizing established procedures, user manuals, accessing various on-line applications, or interacting with internal support groups within a designated timeframe. Log and track calls received using a PC and/or web-based ticket system. Escalates non-routine customer inquiries and concerns to appropriate support groups for resolution. Provided informal and formal classroom training and orientation on the various Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS) applications in the field; provided employee guidance and education on the proper handling of calls received from field. Provided telephonic support to over 765 uniformed Service personnel offices to resolve network, hardware, and software problems. Trained new employees on technical support of the network. Performed configuration management on personal computers (PCs), modems, and hub connections. Serve as technical lead for the implementation and maintenance of EDS Web-based Knowledge Base tool that is being utilized by EDS help desks both inside and outside of the United States.
